brief: The Claude Code stack a one-person founder uses to ship like a 10-person team.

slots.title: 1. Anthropic, the engine
slots.body: Claude Code lives in your terminal. It reads, edits, and tests code across your entire codebase without context switching.

slots.title: 2. GitHub, the workflow
slots.body: Store code, run CI/CD, and manage releases. Actions auto-deploy on every push so you never touch production manually.

slots.title: 3. Next.js, the frontend
slots.body: App Router, Server Components, and API routes in one framework. Vercel edge caching delivers sub-second loads globally.

slots.title: 4. Supabase, the backend
slots.body: Postgres database, auth, and real-time subscriptions without ops. Row-level security handles permissions while you focus on features.

slots.title: 5. Vercel, the platform
slots.body: Zero-config deployments with preview branches for every PR. Analytics and speed insights keep performance visible without extra tools.

slots.title: 6. Stripe, the revenue
slots.body: Billing, subscriptions, and invoicing with webhook-synced events. Claude writes the integration logic while you verify the dashboard.
